Chinese platform wrapper uses original Tone.Offline/Tone.Oscillator to synthesize4–16 sine clicks at40–200BPM, mono22050Hz, duration<=24s. Own PCM16 WAV container/export, no microphone/audio sample/automatic playback/model or external audio. Only one unresolved native offline render permitted. Native OfflineAudioContext cannot be forcibly killed; 8s UI expiry discards result but keeps generation blocked until promise actually settles; input changes/unmount invalidate old output, not pretend canceling native rendering. Browser timers and native engine lifetime not hard execution guarantees. Audio controls require user action. WAV and JSON actual downloads bounded.

The per-document nativePending gate is module-level, survives client unmount/remount, blocks a second pending render until actual settlement even if old output was invalidated. Closed-document/native engine lifetime cannot be guaranteed or forcibly terminated by this wrapper.
